## Email Draft for Toronto Repair Request

Subject: Request for Prompt Repairs: Bathroom Ceiling Leak and Bedroom Paint Damage

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I hope you are well. I am writing to follow up on two maintenance issues in the unit: a leaking bathroom ceiling and peeling paint in the bedroom.

My lease began on **2025-03-01**, and I have continued to pay rent on time. I first reported these issues verbally on **2025-05-02**, but they are still unresolved. The bathroom leak and the deteriorating bedroom paint are now affecting the habitability and comfort of the unit.

I would appreciate it if these repairs could be completed within **7 days** of this email, or if you could let me know by then when the work will be scheduled. I am asking for a prompt repair so the issues do not get worse and the unit remains safe and livable.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I appreciate your help and look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Unit Number]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

## Evidence to Attach

- Photos of the leaking bathroom ceiling
- Photos of the peeling paint in the bedroom
- A short video showing active dripping or water staining, if available
- Copies of any previous written messages about the issue
- A note with the date and time you verbally reported it on **2025-05-02**
- Any photos showing damage spreading or worsening over time

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy Email] <https://example.com/copy-email>
Action: [Button: Save Checklist] <https://example.com/save-checklist>

- Ontario Standard Lease and tenant rights: https://www.ontario.ca/page/guide-ontarios-standard-lease
- Landlord and Tenant Board information: https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/
